posts.title: Two Kinds of Auto-Save in Emacs: Giving Up on the Perfect Save Key!
posts.description: For someone who spends as much time in Emacs as I do, it is faintly ridiculous how much of my configuration time goes on the save keybinding. I have tried the stock chord, a shorter prefix, function keys, and spare keys; each one feels right for a day, and then the search starts again. posts.title: Making Git Changes Obvious in the Emacs Mode Line
posts.description: Emacs already tells you when a version-controlled file has local changes, but it does it with a punctuation mark: a clean file shows Git-master in the mode line, and a modified file shows Git:master . The only difference is the separator, and if the theme leaves the VC state faces unspecified there is not even a colour change. posts.title: Stop Going to the Top: isearch-allow-motion in Emacs
posts.description: I have a small ritual when I need to find something in a file: jump to the top with M-< , start C-s , and type the search string. It works, but it is a little fiddly. The top of the buffer is not where I am, and most of the time I do not actually need to start there.
